Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating

Lunch: Option 1: Brown rice (150 g) + dal (150 g) + vegetable curry (100 g)
Option 2: 2 chapatis + paneer curry (120 g) + salad
Option 3: Millet khichdi (150 g) + mixed veg
Dinner: Option 1: Light vegetable soup (250 ml) + 1 chapati
Option 2: Grilled paneer (120 g) + steamed veg

Notes_and_Tips: When Meals_per_Day=2 prefer later meals and skip breakfast where convenient.
Use portion control and high-fiber options to manage cravings.
Include walking daily to support metabolic health.
Prefer minimally processed foods and whole grains.
